notes.title: Added a new map, new monsters, and Mac support.
notes.content: [p]Update Notes[/p][p]New Monsters & Map[/p][p]We've expanded the world with new monsters and a brand-new map, adding greater depth and challenge to the game.[/p][p]Rare Item Drop Broadcast System[/p][p]Introducing a new server-wide broadcast system for rare item drops! Now, every lucky moment can be a shared celebration for everyone on the server.[/p][p]Fixed English Chat Crash[/p][p]We've resolved a bug where the English chat function would crash due to incorrect string length calculations, improving stability for all language versions.[/p][p]macOS Support Added[/p][p]The game now officially supports the macOS platform, allowing more players to join our adventure![/p][p]Fixed Map Loading Error[/p][p]We have fixed a bug that caused an error when reading or writing to a map that was not fully loaded, which will improve overall stability.[/p][p]Mobile Map Loading Bug[/p][p]Resolved a bug in the mobile dynamic map loading system. We've improved the resource management logic to ensure all assets are properly unloaded, preventing a loading failure on subsequent attempts.[/p][p]Thank you to all the players for your continuous support and encouragement![/p][p]I'm still learning and working hard to bring you more new content and a better gaming experience. If you have any ideas, suggestions, or run into any issues, feel free to reach out to me through the community or Discord.[/p][p]Onward, adventurers! The journey continues![/p]

notes.title: Bug fixes and new tasks
notes.content: I would like to express my sincere gratitude to all users who reported bugs. Without your help, it would have been difficult for me to identify these issues. We have fixed the following: guild chat abnormalities, server-side exceptions preventing client connections, server-side voice chat memory leaks, equipment anomalies, the issue where only the team leader gained experience, and optimized the damage calculation formula. Additionally, we have added new main storyline guidance quests and bounty missions.
